verdict.rationale: Parsec is a proprietary SaaS remote-desktop service. The evidence shows only that users run the host app on their own machines with peer-to-peer connections, and that Enterprise customers can place a Parsec relay inside their firewall. Neither amounts to self-hosting the core product: there is no evidence of a self-hostable control plane, broker, or authentication service, and the relay is an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The Parsec high-performance relay is also available to Enterprise customers so your team can connect through a relay point in your firewall.
